explanation: Merge of main into the staleness pass. From main: Only the expression survey runbook and project guidance wording changed, describing how the gene page shows and opens each survey source. Adding or changing a dataset, its bundles, the expression catalog entries and their checks follow the same steps and commands as before. The rename work adds one step: a dataset that changes the nomenclature table also needs pnpm run build:search-names, which regenerates the search names and the rename groups from nomenclature.tsv; project guidance states the order, the --check guard and the rule tests. From this branch: Text-only changes to usage headers and dated records, plus bundleWriter.mts taking NSIG_FDR_THRESHOLD from the shared NSIG_FDR_CUTOFF (same 0.05, so bundles are unchanged); report_september5_intake.py emits the dated header and current-audit note so regeneration keeps them.
